title: Goldspire Territories
kicker: A vast bright frontier-fantasy territory of walled cities, giant forests, wet villages, relay towers, old roads, and cheerful safety...
hook: A vast bright frontier-fantasy territory of walled cities, giant forests, wet villages, relay towers, old roads, and cheerful safety promises that never quite cover the cracks.

blocks.label: Arrival Read
blocks.body: Goldspire is not one city. It is a huge territory of paved capitals, painted forest roads, mossy villages, quarry towns, river markets, ridge relays, and old magic under newer paperwork.

blocks.label: Known For
blocks.body: Gigantic forests, courier roads, territory capitals, branded protection, moss villages, bright markets, relay towers, and older magic that refuses to become a product.

blocks.label: What Is Here
blocks.body: Local residents or workers appropriate to the place hybrid forest wildlife, courier birds, canal frogs, ridge goats, market beetles, domestic pack animals No default combatant; add only if the scene introduces one Emeris Crown Holdings Goldwater Financial...

blocks.label: Food And Texture
blocks.body: Road food changes by region: fried gate dough in Emeris, moss-honey bread in Hush, hot quarry stews, bright market skewers, strong forest tonics, and suspiciously cheerful packaged remedies from city manufactories.

affordances: Look for the busiest local gathering point.
Ask what has changed here recently.
